pages.title: Thrown, Not Dropped
pages.text: Right-click to throw one iron dagger down your view. It strikes what is in the way for 6 damage and then comes back to you — the dagger leaves your stack for the throw, not out of your life.

$(bold)One at a time$(br)Every throw spends one dagger and throws exactly one, on the danmaku item cooldown — 20 ticks by default. The $(bold)Dagger Glove$() is the same blade fired as a pattern rather than singly.$(br2)$(bold)It always comes back$(br)A thrown dagger returns to your inventory, or drops at your feet when you have no room for it, as soon as it hits a block, hits a creature, or has flown its full two seconds. There is no way to lose a dagger by throwing it; the only dagger you ever lose is one with nobody left to return it to.$(br2)$(bold)It stops where it lands$(br)Unlike the heavier danmaku, a dagger does not pass through what it hits: it deals its damage and ends there. Walls and closed doors stop it in the ordinary way.
